title: Site Model — launchd unit-writers (macOS adapter)
description: The launchd instance of generic unit-writers (guide §3 / map §4.1, D36): exactly one writer per unit-name prefix. Two writers on one prefix is a lint failure. Other supervisors (systemd, runit, Jobber, …) get the same rule; this file is the first adapter, not the model.

domain.description: The launchd label namespace, as a domain of device state (D16(d)). Comprehensive means: any loaded launchd job whose label matches no declared prefix is reported as an extra entry.

prefix.description: Reverse-DNS label prefix ending in `.*`, e.g. `org.tendcf.*`. bin/schema_lint.py additionally rejects a prefix nested inside another — two writers over one namespace is exactly the hazard this file exists to prevent, and nesting is how it comes back.

writer.description: The single tool permitted to write labels under this prefix.

repo.description: Where that writer's definition lives, when it is ours.
